Package models.users

Class Teacher

java.lang.Object
models.users.User
models.users.Employee
models.users.Teacher
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Teacher extends Employee
Represents a Teacher in the university system. Teachers can put marks, send complaints, and view their assigned courses.
